official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Set is a 3D studio for shots of devices showing your own work: an app, a site, a video, a design. It runs in your browser at setdesign.app. Set Design connects ChatGPT to the Set window you have open, so you can ask for a shot in words and watch it being built.

ChatGPT can put devices on the stage (phones, tablets, laptops, watches and displays), put an image or a video from a public address on a screen, frame the camera the way a product shot does, set the lights, backdrop, floor, lens and each device's colour and finish, add motion from Set's presets, look at the frame, and export stills and video to your computer.

Every change happens in your Set window, where you can see it, and each one is a single step of undo there. A setting Set does not have, or a value outside a control's range, is refused in words rather than quietly changed. Rendering happens in your browser on your own graphics hardware, and exports save to your computer. You can ask from ChatGPT on any device; the shot is built in the Set window on your computer.

What you need: a Set Pro licence, Set open in a desktop browser and signed in with it, and Assistant switched on in Set's sidebar. When you connect, a page on setdesign.app asks you to allow ChatGPT. The setup is at setdesign.app/assistant.
